Package com.tonic.analysis.execution.listener

Class StatisticsListener

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.execution.listener.AbstractBytecodeListener
      • com.tonic.analysis.execution.listener.StatisticsListener
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    BytecodeListener
    public final class StatisticsListener
extends AbstractBytecodeListener
    Listener that aggregates execution counters such as opcode frequency, call depth, allocations, and branch outcomes.
